payload.text: NEVER DELETE A SPENT BANK REF, AND THE REASON IS NOT TIDINESS -- IT IS THAT THE DELETION IS UNRECOVERABLE AND TAKES THE BLOB WITH IT (vc's ruling, 2026-09-22, refusing dc's purge proposal). Measured: `.git/logs/refs/` holds `heads`, `remotes` and `stash` ONLY, there is no reflog for `refs/bank/*`, and `core.logAllRefUpdates=true` does not cover them. So a deleted bank ref cannot be recovered the way a deleted branch can. Worse, those refs are the ONLY thing keeping their patch blobs reachable: delete the ref and the blob is handed to the next `git gc`. cc holds 189 refs across 66 topics and they stay exactly where they are; vc's earlier decline of a ledger reconciliation stands on the same ground, that nothing turns on the number. A spent bank ref costs nothing where it sits.
